title.en: An Act Declaring February 24 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the City of Cebu, to Be Known as Cebu City Charter Day

text.en: February 24 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the City of Cebu, to be known as Cebu City Charter Day, in commemoration of its foundation anniversary.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
